theme.title: NBA Mix 15
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Larry Bird's 1998 Pacers win?
questions.note: 58 wins in Bird's first coaching season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 58–24 record

funFacts.text: Larry Bird became Indiana's coach before this season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: The Pacers acquired Chris Mullin from Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired All-Star forward Chris Mullin from the Golden State Warriors

funFacts.text: Indiana drafted Providence forward Austin Croshere twelfth overall.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
